g.text: F3 Completed-attempt failures and finite-window outcomes
4 agents; dependency 0; avoidance 0; fixed repair clock
First-order q = 1 − exp(−μE): dispatch uses E = δ + R; re-reading uses E = R = 0.25. At δ = 0 both use E = R.
All ratios pool 30 seeds. Aggregate inputs do not identify ratio intervals. Completed attempts are selected by the queue and cutoff.
μ is nominal; the vertical line marks waiting time 1/μ. Windows are fixed per p; no uncensored mean or dispatch distribution is inferred.
